rules.statement: The mere purchase at a Fiscal's sale by the third defendant of the shares mortgaged was ineffective to defeat the plaintiff's right as mortgagee, but the subsequent action by the third defendant in obtaining delivery of possession of the shares rendered her liable to the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: "But in this case the third defendant has gone one step further. She has shortly prior to the action obtained herself registered as owner of the shares and, in my opinion, she must now be regarded as having obtained delivery of possession of the shares in question."
